text:
Maria: hey folks — updated the PR with the fixes from yesterday's review: removed the global default, clarified error handling. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482
Sam: looking now, thanks. did you keep backward compat for /v1/generate? that's the main concern.
Maria: yep — kept the old param mapping. added deprecation header to response for new param name. pushed commit 7a9f3b
ci-bot: build passed — linux/amd64 tests ✅ (run 3845678920)
Jordan: quick q: when the prompt is empty we used to return 400, now code returns 422 — intentional?
Maria: good catch — I changed it to 422 to match new client expectations per spec. here's the snippet:
```
if prompt.strip() == "":
    raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="prompt cannot be empty")
```
Lee: hm can we keep 400 for legacy clients and map 422 in new? worried about consumers sniffing 422 as transient
Maria: i added a compatibility flag `legacyMode` in the handler; default is false but tenant config flips it. see handler changes in the last commit
Sam: can you add a short note in the PR description about the compatibility toggle and include a migration note?
Maria: done — PR description updated and added a tiny migration snippet
Jordan: LGTM from me after that. PTAL @Sam
Sam: PTAL now — tests look good, one nit: drop the trailing whitespace in handlers.py and squash if you want
Maria: removed whitespace and squashed into single commit; pushed
ci-bot: canary deploy queued (canary-1) — ETA ~10m
Maria: thanks — ready to merge once canary is green. tagging for merge window
Sam: approve :thumbsup:
Jordan: approve
Lee: minor nit resolved, approve
Maria: merging in 5 if no objections — thanks team :rocket:
